reason: We have to replace lost volume and my two account managers will not hunt new logos, so I would take the free 15-company list and, if it holds up, sign the pilot in relationship mode. With the first 3 meetings free and a EUR 900 cap, one new freight account pays it back many times over, so the numbers are not the problem.
objection: My name is on every message. If they spam forwarders and shippers in a market where everyone knows everyone, or the GDPR side is sloppy, that costs me more than EUR 900. And one logistics client with 45 meetings in 2 months is one story, not a track record. I want to know how many of those turned into quotes.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 target companies are generic names I already know, or they will not show me the meeting-to-quote rate from that logistics client, I walk away after step 1.
